days.chapter_or_section: Positioning a Product: Milk Duds — read the complete bounded chapter
days.fundamental: A product wins when it occupies a simple, defensible mental position against the alternatives already in the prospect's mind.

days.chapter_or_section: The Power of Context — bounded reading of the chapter's opening section and core examples
days.fundamental: The context surrounding an offer changes its perceived value, so behavior can shift without changing the underlying object.

days.chapter_or_section: The Technology Progress Paradox — bounded section on why improvement can outrun customer needs
days.fundamental: Sustaining improvement can overshoot what mainstream customers value, opening room for simpler disruptive solutions.

days.chapter_or_section: Chapter Two: Determining If Your Product Is Must-Have — bounded reading through the product-market fit survey and interpretation
days.fundamental: Growth becomes durable when a meaningful share of users would be genuinely very disappointed to lose the product.

days.fundamental: Visuals earn their place when they clarify, dramatize, or intensify the promise rather than merely decorate the message.
